description: Large Bitcoin transactions (total output >= minBtc, default 10 BTC): every transaction of the latest 1-2 confirmed blocks (mempool.space block summaries), plus the ~10 newest unconfirmed transactions blockchain.info exposes. Returns txid, output value in BTC (includes change), fee rate sat/vB, RBF signal and block height or 'mempool'. `scanned` states exactly what was read. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_node_diversity when you need Reachable Bitcoin nodes from the latest bitnodes.io; crypto_btc_block when you need Detailed Bitcoin block summary by height or hash. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Number of latest confirmed blocks to scan completely (1-2, default 1)

minBtc.description: Minimum total output value in BTC (default 10, 0.01 to 100000)

title: Large Bitcoin transactions: every transaction of the latest
